description: Permanently delete a receipt and its stored file. This is a HARD delete — the row, its line items, and any Bewirtungsbeleg/Eigenbeleg overlay go with it, and there is no undo and no recycle bin. Confirm with the user before calling. To move a receipt to a different transaction use detach_receipt + attach_receipt instead; deleting loses the extraction.

receiptId.description: Receipt id to delete (from list_receipts output).

name: delete_receipt
